preeminent--adj.def: Better than all others in a particular field.
preeminent--adj.ex: He is the preeminent scholar of the period.
preeminent--adj.exTr: Dönemin en önde gelen bilim insanı.

prescriptive--adj.def: Telling people what they ought to do rather than describing them.
prescriptive--adj.ex: The guide is descriptive, not prescriptive.

presentational--adj.def: Concerning how something is shown rather than its content.

preservationist--noun.def: Someone who works to protect old buildings or nature.

pressurization--noun.def: The keeping of air pressure steady inside a sealed space.

pressurize--verb.def: To keep air pressure inside something, or to force someone to act.
pressurize--verb.ex: Do not pressurize her into signing.

presuppose--verb.def: To depend on something being true before anything else.

presupposition--noun.def: Something taken as true before an argument begins.

prise--verb.def: To force something open or apart with a tool.
prise--verb.ex: He prised the lid off the tin.

profitability--noun.def: The ability of a business to make money.
profitability--noun.ex: Profitability fell for a third year.

promotable--adj.def: Good enough to be raised to a higher position.
promotable--adj.ex: Only two staff are promotable now.
promotable--adj.exTr: Şu an yalnızca iki personel terfi ettirilebilir.

proportionally--adv.def: In an amount that matches the size of something else.

proprietorial--adj.def: Behaving as if you own someone or something.

protrude--verb.def: To stick out beyond a surface.
protrude--verb.ex: A nail protrudes from the plank.

protrusion--noun.def: A part that sticks out from a surface.

prurience--noun.def: An unhealthy interest in sexual matters.

prurient--adj.def: Showing too great an interest in sexual matters.

punitively--adv.def: In a way meant as punishment.

qualitative--adj.def: Concerning the nature of something rather than its amount.

qualm--noun.def: A feeling of doubt about whether something is right.
qualm--noun.ex: He had no qualms about lying.

rapturous--adj.ex: The play got a rapturous welcome.

recumbent--adj.def: Lying down, especially in a restful position.
recumbent--adj.ex: A recumbent figure fills the painting.

recuperation--noun.def: The period of getting better after illness.

recuperative--adj.def: Helping someone to recover their health.

redundantly--adv.def: In a way that repeats what is already covered.
redundantly--adv.ex: The clause redundantly restates the rule.

reissue--verb.def: To publish or release something again.
reissue--verb.ex: They reissued the album on vinyl.

relegate--verb.def: To move someone or something to a lower position.
relegate--verb.ex: The club was relegated last May.

remittance--noun.def: Money sent to someone, often from abroad.

remonstrance--noun.def: A strong complaint made in protest.

remonstrate--verb.def: To protest firmly to someone about their behaviour.

resoundingly--adv.def: In a way nobody can doubt.

retrospection--noun.def: The act of looking back over past events.
retrospection--noun.ex: Retrospection makes the choice look easy.

revelatory--adj.def: Showing something important that was not known before.

reverb--noun.def: The echoing effect added to a recorded sound.

reverberate--verb.def: To echo loudly, or to have lasting effects.

reverberation--noun.def: A returning sound, or a lasting consequence.

revile--verb.def: To criticize someone with fierce hatred.
revile--verb.ex: The press reviled him for months.
revile--verb.exTr: Basın onu aylarca yerin dibine batırdı.

rhetorically--adv.def: In terms of persuasive style, or without wanting an answer.
rhetorically--adv.ex: He asked rhetorically and moved on.
rhetorically--adv.exTr: Cevap beklemeden sordu ve devam etti.

romper--noun.def: A one-piece garment for a small child.
romper--noun.ex: The baby wore a striped romper.

ruminant--adj.def: Belonging to the group of animals that chew again.

ruminate--verb.def: To think about something for a long time.

rumination--noun.def: Long slow thought about a subject.
rumination--noun.ex: The book is a rumination on loss.
rumination--noun.exTr: Kitap, kayıp üzerine derin bir düşünme.

ruminative--adj.def: Thoughtful in a slow, inward way.
ruminative--adj.ex: He fell into a ruminative silence.

salivary--adj.def: Relating to the glands that produce saliva.

selectivity--noun.def: The care taken in choosing only certain things.
selectivity--noun.ex: The school is known for its selectivity.

self-aggrandizement--noun.def: The act of making yourself seem more important.
self-aggrandizement--noun.exTr: Anı kitabı baştan sona kendini yüceltme.

shamble--verb.def: To walk slowly and awkwardly without lifting the feet.

sheaf--noun.def: A bundle of papers or stalks tied together.
sheaf--noun.ex: She carried a sheaf of notes.

side-step--verb.def: To avoid a question or problem rather than face it.

skew--verb.def: To change results so they no longer show the truth.
skew--verb.exTr: Tek bir aykırı değer ortalamayı çarpıtıyor.

smattering--noun.def: A small and incomplete amount of knowledge or things.
smattering--noun.ex: He has a smattering of Greek.

snippet--noun.def: A small piece of news, text or sound.
snippet--noun.ex: She played a snippet of the song.

snobbery--noun.def: The belief that your taste or class makes you superior.

soliloquize--verb.def: To speak your thoughts aloud while alone.
soliloquize--verb.ex: The actor soliloquizes in the dark.

solipsism--noun.def: The view that only your own mind can be known to exist.

solitariness--noun.ex: He prizes the solitariness of the hills.

spatially--adv.def: In terms of space and position.

spuriously--adv.def: In a false way that appears genuine.

squirmy--adj.def: Unable to keep still, or causing uneasiness.
squirmy--adj.ex: The child grew squirmy in the queue.

stoicism--noun.def: The acceptance of pain or trouble without complaint.
stoicism--noun.ex: She bore the loss with stoicism.

stringently--adv.def: In a strict way that allows no exceptions.

stultify--verb.def: To make someone dull or an effort useless.

stultifyingly--adv.def: So dully that the mind stops working.

subsist--verb.def: To stay alive with only a little food or money.
subsist--verb.ex: They subsist on rice and beans.

subsistence--noun.def: The condition of having just enough to stay alive.
subsistence--noun.ex: The family lives at subsistence level.

suffuse--verb.def: To spread through something, said of colour or feeling.

sulphuric--adj.def: Containing sulphur, as in a strong acid.

summarily--adv.def: Done at once and without the usual procedure.

superfluously--adv.def: In a way that adds more than is needed.

surreptitious--adj.def: Done secretly so that nobody notices.

surreptitiously--adv.def: In a way meant to escape notice.

syllabic--adj.def: Relating to the syllables that make up words.
syllabic--adj.exTr: Japonca heceye dayalı bir yazı kullanır.

tacit--adj.def: Understood and accepted without being said.

taciturn--adj.ex: Her father was a taciturn man.

taciturnity--noun.def: The habit of speaking very little.
